title: Decentralized Multi-Agent Concurrency Control: Git Worktree Isolation & Optimistic File Lease Protocol
target_platform: macOS / Git 2.40+ Worktrees & Filesystem Coordination Ledger
hypothesis: Synthesizing upstream agent-plugins-skills orchestration doctrine (orchestrating-agent-work worktree confinement, running-control-plane pre-worktree reconciliation, and multi-worktree non-overlapping ownership) into a zero-daemon coordination ledger (.agent/coordination/leases.jsonl) allows multiple heterogeneous AI CLI agents (AGY, Claude Code, Codex, MLX) to execute parallel research missions on isolated git worktrees (.worktrees/<agent>-<mission>/) with 0 file-clobbering collisions, 0 pre-worktree dirty-state leakage, and 100% clean squash-merges.
falsification_criteria: Two concurrent agents modify overlapping file paths without lease detection, an agent commits un-staged files belonging to a peer agent, a new worktree inherits uncommitted dirty files from main without reconciliation, or worktree provisioning latency exceeds 2.0 seconds.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Escalate to frontier model only if concurrent git worktree rebase requires three-way semantic AST merge

lessons_learned: Git worktree isolation combined with atomic zero-daemon flight board leases enables safe concurrent multi-agent pairing with zero file clobbering.

related_missions.MISSION-052: CONSUMER: MISSION-052 exercises the board with four concurrent leased worktrees.
related_missions.MISSION-059: RELATED TO MISSION-059: CONSUMES CONTEXT: assesses the existing worktree and lease coordination boundary; does not assume it is a security sandbox.
